scientific_limitations: Specific to the full 126-point E7 root system and exact-degree harmonics. Earliest directly motivating source with verifiable day-stamped public posting is arXiv:1308.5101 (2013-08-23); the older root/design literature has historical 1976/1977 bibliographic years but no verified original public-posting day. Previous equivalent association-scheme treatments are a residual novelty risk.
title: All-degree spherical-harmonic sampling spectra on the 126 roots of \(E_7\)
